candidate_program.name: damped_cover_displacement
candidate_program.rationale: Uses root-conditioned cover displacement as a bounded correction to degree density. Global partitions can respond to remote arrangement changes, but heuristic cover differences can be unstable and two global cover computations may dominate the budget.

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
